sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 37024 of 2023
Applicant :- Ms Singh Medical Agency
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And 2 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Udai Prakash Deo Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Sri Udai Prakash Deo Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Rajeev Kumar Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The present application has been filed to quash the entire criminal proceedings arising out of Criminal Complaint Case No.8690 of 2023 (State Vs. Saurabh Chaurasiya and others), u/s 26/59 and 52 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, Police Station-Robertsganj, District-Sonbhadra,
pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sonbhadra and also quash the summoning order dated 13.06.2023 passed by the In-charge Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sonbhadra and also quash the bailable warrants dated 01.07.2023 and 28.08.2023 against the applicant issued by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sonbhadra.
3.

entities.text: Criminal Complaint Case No.8690 of 2023 (State Vs. Saurabh Chaurasiya and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant does not want to press the prayer for quashing the impugned proceeding and want to surrender before the court Ms Singh Medical Agency vs State Of U.P.And 2 Others on 8 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63006154/
1 below and apply for bail.

entities.text: Ms Singh Medical Agency vs State Of U.P.And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that this court may be pleased to direct the court concerned to consider the bail application of the applicant, expeditiously, within stipulated period of time as may be fixed by this court.

4. Considering the aforesaid submission, it is provided that if the applicant surrenders and moves an application for bail before the court below within a period of three weeks from today, then his application shall be considered in view of the law laid down in Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and Another, (2021) 10 SCC 773.
5.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and Another, (2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For a period of four weeks or till disposal of the bail application, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
6. With the aforesaid observations, present application is disposed of.
